description: Keep the tip of a passive-shoulder, powered-elbow brass acrobot above a visible height marker for 1.2 seconds.
name: Elbow Engine V2 · Difficulty 1 · Simplified Interaction
natural_language: Start the engine. Apply negative, neutral, or positive elbow torque to keep the glowing free tip above the green height marker for 1.2 seconds continuously. A changing external load acts on the elbow and is displayed beside the controls. The ceiling hinge is passive. Submit after the height-hold meter fills. Only use screenshots and visible task webpage controls; do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden implementation state. Stay on the task tab; only tabs opened by visible task controls as part of the task may be used.
